people.name: Peniel
people.line: A place where Jacob wrestled with God

translations.web: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.
translations.bsb: The sun rose above him as he passed by Penuel, and he was limping because of his hip.
translations.kjv: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
translations.asv: And the sun rose upon him as he passed over Penuel, and he limped upon his thigh.
